title: Beautiful!
text:
Beautiful!. This rug is exactly as pictured! It is a distressed, cream rug with touches of teal and and light brown and matches perfectly to my living room decor. The rug itself is good quality and very soft! The corners do roll up a bit from being rolled up in shipment but I’ve just set some of my old textbooks on the edges to sit for a few days and that should do the trick. Excellent rug for an excellent price, highly suggest!

** Edit 8/09/21: the rug corners have now relaxed and are not an issue at all. The rug has gotten softer over time as well. Excellent quality!!!

features: Actual Dimensions: 7 feet 8 inches Width by 10 Feet 6 inches Length.Construction type:Machine Made

STYLISH AREA RUG: Designed using an impeccable blend of a traditional oriental rug and modern distressed rug styles, this 8x10 transitional area rug makes a bold statement in every floor and space it covers.

OPTIMAL COMFORT: This stylish area rug has a medium pile that delivers cushioned comfort to your feet and body, easily fits under any piece of furniture. Soft, plush feeling fibers are machine-woven for durability.

LOW MAINTENANCE: This 8x10 Area rug is stain-resistant and easy to clean. It requires vacuuming without a beater bar or spot-cleaning for only a few minutes. It is equally suitable for low and high traffic areas and only needs light maintenance..GREAT LOOK: With its classic hues, it smoothly compliments the look and mood of sitting rooms, dining rooms, and bedrooms, bringing every piece of furniture and décor together to create an aesthetically pleasing environment.
Product Note : Rugs may contain temporary creases upon arrival, allow time for creases to flatten and settle
